ir.name: loss_log_ratio_softplus_advantage_scaleinv
ir.intuition: Normalize the log-probability ratio by the sum of magnitudes to achieve scale-invariance, then apply an exponential scaling on the advantage gap before computing the softplus loss. This ensures that the loss remains stable under arbitrary scaling of log probabilities.
ir.pseudocode:
ratio = log_prob_w - log_prob_l
norm_factor = abs(log_prob_w) + abs(log_prob_l) + epsilon
scale_factor = exp(advantage_gap)
scaled_ratio = (ratio / norm_factor) * scale_factor
loss = softplus(-scaled_ratio) * weight
final_loss = mean(loss)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    adv_gap = batch['advantage_gap']
    weight = batch.get('weight', None)
    eps = 1e-8
    ratio = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    norm_factor = ops.add(ops.abs(lpw), ops.abs(lpl))
    norm_factor = ops.add(norm_factor, eps)
    normed_ratio = ops.div(ratio, norm_factor)
    scale_factor = ops.exp(adv_gap)
    scaled_ratio = ops.mul(normed_ratio, scale_factor)
    loss = ops.softplus(ops.neg(scaled_ratio))
    if weight is not None:
        loss = ops.mul(loss, weight)
    return ops.mean(loss)
